archetypes.name: bgjob-owner-regression
archetypes.rationale: Checks that the plan and diff pin stable bgjob owner identity across Step 3 and sibling launch paths without flaky timing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the implementation for stable bgjob owner coverage. Focus on Step 3, Step 7a env fallback, and any launcher that could still use a transient foreground wrapper pid. Confirm tests use fake or static seams and no real sleeps. Check that the #6591 comment step is file-backed and comment-only. Cite each finding with path and line evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
